title: Cold chain
description: Temperature-controlled handling requirement anchored to Good Distribution Practice (GDP) cold-chain classes. Elective and NEVER default-on: composed only when the goods require temperature control. Commits the cold-chain class, the agreed temperature window in whole degrees Celsius, and the agreed recording interval — no external standard mandates a single interval (GDP says continuous, EU 37/2005 says frequent and regular, WHO PQS allows 1–15 min), so the interval is a term the parties commit. The external standard is the source of truth; this clause references it. The temperature RECORD produced during custody is filed as a runtime attestation at stage 1 (one attestation per reporting period); excursion and MKT are derived at read time from the witnessed range against the committed window, never stored.

fields.name: tempClass
fields.label: Cold-chain class
fields.description: GDP cold-chain class. The explicit min/max window below pins the agreed range within the class.

fields.name: tempMinC
fields.label: Min temperature (°C)
fields.description: Minimum allowable temperature in whole degrees Celsius.

fields.name: tempMaxC
fields.label: Max temperature (°C)
fields.description: Maximum allowable temperature in whole degrees Celsius. Must be ≥ tempMinC (checked off-chain at read time).

fields.name: recordingIntervalSeconds
fields.label: Recording interval (seconds)
fields.description: The agreed temperature-recording interval in seconds. Fit-for-purpose per the referenced standard (data loggers commonly record every 300–900 s); compliance of the filed record against this interval is derived at read time.

fields.name: monitoringStandard
fields.label: Monitoring standard
fields.description: Free-form reference to the recording/monitoring standard the parties follow (e.g. "EN 12830", "USP <1079>", "WHO PQS E006") — any standard, existing or future; the protocol takes no closed list.

1.name: periodStart
1.label: Period start
1.description: Start of the reporting period this record covers.

1.name: periodEnd
1.label: Period end
1.description: End of the reporting period this record covers.

1.name: observedMinC
1.label: Observed min (°C)
1.description: Lowest temperature recorded over the period, whole degrees Celsius.

1.name: observedMaxC
1.label: Observed max (°C)
1.description: Highest temperature recorded over the period, whole degrees Celsius.

1.name: evidenceUri
1.label: Record evidence
1.description: Optional reference to the full off-chain logger record (time series, excursion report, MKT calculation).
